<style> 
:root { 
  --neon-blue: oklch(65% 0.3 260); 
  --flame-red: oklch(60% 0.3 20); 
  --carbon-base: oklch(15% 0.01 260); 
  --glass-edge: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); 
} 

body { 
  background-color: #050505; 
  color: #fff; 
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; 
  overflow-x: hidden; 
  overscroll-behavior: none; 
} 

::view-transition-old(root), 
::view-transition-new(root) { 
  animation-duration: 0.8s; 
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0, 1); 
} 

.portal-container { 
  position: fixed; 
  inset: -10vh -10vw; 
  z-index: 0; 
  clip-path: polygon(0 0, 88% 8%, 100% 100%, 12% 92%); 
  pointer-events: none; 
  transform: scale(1.05); 
} 

/* CORRECCIÓN APLICADA AQUÍ */
.portal-backdrop { 
  position: absolute; 
  inset: 0; 
  /* Se reemplaza el blur destructivo por un gradiente radial que funde los bordes pero deja el centro nítido */
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0%, rgba(5,5,5,0.8) 60%, rgba(5,5,5,1) 100%);
} 

@keyframes kinetic-shimmer { 
  0% { background-position: 200% center; } 
  100% { background-position: -200% center; } 
} 

.text-kinetic { 
  background: linear-gradient( 
    90deg, 
    var(--neon-blue) 0%, 
    #ffffff 25%, 
    var(--flame-red) 50%, 
    #ffffff 75%, 
    var(--neon-blue) 100% 
  );

  color: transparent;
